author: Faithh
body:
Hello, I was recently banned a bit ago for a reason in which I believe to be an accusation rather than an actual offence. I've been playing on Avicus for a little over a year, and I love it. I'm quite disappointed by the fact how I was accused of an offence and then just banned for apparently hacking- a.k.a "aimbot." I was playing a match of Destroy the Monument for about 15 minutes or so, and a mod started asking me questions such as "Do you know what happens to naughty boi's like you, Faithh?" And in all honesty, I had no idea what was going on as I was just playing the game. Other players in the chat were saying things such as "BAN!" or "REKT." Truly, I was confused and I asked the mod what I did. What happened was he, or she, said something along the lines of "Well, there's this thing called aimbot.." Of course, I knew this wasn't true and was just an accusation. I feared getting banned since I loved playing on this server. I said something along the lines of "What? I don't know what is happening??" After that, all that was said by the mod was something like "bye bye, now," and I was banned. There were a few other things said in which I don't remember, but I know they don't have much significance. I don't mean to be disrespectful in any way, but I find it quiet offensive to be just accused of something without me knowing what is going on, AND without any proper explanation of the situation. If someone really, truly was convinced I was hacking, I'd like to be provided with proof of this. Personally, it should have been handled better. I am politely asking to be unbanned. I enjoyed playing on Avicus and I have been a loyal player for a little more than a year. I've never had any mishaps with any staff members before, nor have I ever been banned or warned about something. I hope this can be worked out since i'd love to be back playing on the server once again. Thank you. 

My IGN is Faithh
